bill.title: Businesses: other; Michigan zoning enabling act; make subject to the data center community benefit act. Amends sec. 205 of 2006 PA 110 (MCL 125.3205).  TIE BAR WITH: SB 1050'26

posted_text:
🏢 MI SB 1051 — Michigan Zoning Could Now Tie to Renewable Energy

This bill would link county and township zoning decisions to a suite of Michigan environmental and energy laws, including those related to electric transmission lines, regional transit, and small wireless communications facilities. Specifically, it would require local regulations to align with the data center community benefit act. ...
